item.title: J.H. Rose wrestler makes history heading to state tournament
item.description: PITT COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- J.H. Rose senior Nyima Lovett is headed to the NCHSAA 6A State Championship as the first female Rampant wrestler ever to make the state tournament. item.title: Teen hospitalized after accidental gunshot wound in Washington
item.description: WASHINGTON, N.C. (WNCT) -- A 15-year-old male was airlifted to ECU Health Medical Center in Greenville after suffering from an apparent gunshot wound to the head. The Washington Police Department said, "preliminary information indicates the shooting appears to have been accidental and the result of mishandling a handgun by the victim.
